title: [neoforge] Kryeit Gold
description: MoronicMercury's personal modpack for the kryeit server. Adds advanced Performance and Feature Mods.
body:
![Closeup of kryeit cog made of glass and metal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2c447df9ada9da36111d28fc8f9853452bdcaf2d_0.webp)
# [NEOFORGE] Kryeit Gold is the personal modpack of MoronicMerkury, a kryeit server admin. 
### Important keybind: 
- [ CTRL + S + L ] toggle light level overlay
# Mods on top of Base Pack:
### Performance
* **Bobby ReNeoForged**: Saves chunks from server, allowing higher render distance.
* **EntityCulling**: Improves FPS by preventing the game from rendering entities behind walls.
* **Ferrite Core**: Reduces your game's overall RAM usage, helping with stability.
* **GPU Memory Leak Fix**: Repairs common GPU memory leaks
* **ImmediatelyFast**: Optimizes the rendering pipeline to boost FPS
* **ModernFix**: Fixes various bugs
* **Nowheel**: Culls create components behind walls.
* **Sodium**: A complete rewrite of the rendering engine

### Utility & Quality of Life
* **AutoTorchSet**: Automates the placement of torches
* **BoccHUD**: A customizable Heads-Up Display, rearrange and track various in-game statistics.
* **Carpet: NeoForged**: Adds a suite of technical tools favored by technical players.
* **Full Brightness Toggle**:See in the dark.
* **Map Link**: Provides functionality for syncing waypoints from bluemap.
* **MemGuard**: Managing Java's garbage collection more effectively.
* **Pixelshot**: Mod for high-resolution screenshots and perform better camera control.
* **Tweakerge**: A utility mod that offers various small toggelable "tweaks"
